name: New Brunswick: catalogue of bills given Royal Assent (metadata only, no law text) and legal-system facts
label: New Brunswick
record_note: Metadata only, no law text: the official laws site could not be read by automated means. The catalogue lists the 1637 bills given Royal Assent from 1996-12-19 to 2026-06-12 (53rd Legislature, 1st session to the 61st Legislature, 3rd session), each dated by its assent day, with title and bill number; checked against the Legislative Assembly records on 2026-10-30.

dates.commit: catalogue: the Royal Assent day; legal-system: the dated Wikidata fact, else the item's latest revision

reuse: No law text is reproduced. Bill numbers, titles and assent dates are facts recorded by the Legislative Assembly of New Brunswick; the legal-system facts are from Wikidata (CC0).
